title: Unit Event — Stick to Your Faith — Episode8 Be Like Her

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need are gearing up to make their professional debut. As their label considers how best to market the band, Mr. Shindo asks the girls what music they aspire to.

rows.Line: Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That really happened...?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So you decided to start playing the bass right after you saw that show?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. When I saw Sumire perform, I thought...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I wanna be like her.
I wanna keep doing what I love.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wanna put on shows that can move people's hearts like her band did.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Then, Shih, that really is the thing that matters to you most!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You wanting to become just like your hero by learning to put on cool performances...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <It sounds like that's the root of your music!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Yeah...
She's the reason I started playing the bass and got serious about music...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Which means I want my music to be about...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I've got my answer.
I know what I want my music to be about now.
bgm_area00001
A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like Ichika and the others are here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, Shiho. I hope we didn't keep you waiting too long.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's okay. I mean, I'm the one who asked everyone to gather early on short notice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You said there's something you wanted to talk about, Shiho. Can you tell us what?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's about what Mr. Shindo asked us the other day. I thought it through and found my answer, so I want you all to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'd love to hear what you've come up with.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks. So, that same day, I ended up telling Rin about something that happened when I was in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In elementary school?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, she told me about why she decided to start playing the bass! After seeing a show by a band called Iolite!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, isn't that the girl band you really look up to?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I remember that as well.
You started playing the bass in the hopes that you'd be able to touch people's hearts with your music just like them, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And after looking back on what happened...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My feelings haven't changed. I still wanna put on performances that move people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because that's what matters to me most.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, I think that moving someone's heart can be a way to give them encouragement...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Encouragement?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There was a time in elementary school when I wondered if it was okay for me to do what I wanted at the risk of upsetting everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But what I saw that band do...
I thought it was the coolest thing in the world the way they pursued what they really loved.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why I wanna put on shows like that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wanna move people's hearts while holding onto what I care about most...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And if somebody going through the same thing I did back then hears me play...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe they'll realize that it's okay to be yourself and do what your heart says. I wanna put on those kinds of performances for them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's what I want my music to be about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
That makes a lot of sense coming from you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Especially with how much encouragement your performances have given us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Wait, that means...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've been putting on all those shows and performances while keeping in mind what that band did for you, Shih!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I guess so.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's so amazing, Shiho...
Your feelings from back then haven't changed at all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As for me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to keep performing with all of you. Our music is something only the four of us can create, and my hope is that we get to keep sharing it with our audience...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I can't say right now what I want our music to be about or how I'm going to help make that happen...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is really important, so I don't want to give Mr. Shindo a half-baked response.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I promise to find the answer. I just need a little more time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
There's no rush...
And I'm sure you'll find the answer you're looking for, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you all so much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, then... Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You have to tell us all about this show you saw during elementary school! It isn't fair if only Rin gets to hear your story.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe☆ Lucky me, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm also curious...
It might be good for us to all hear what actually happened.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree.
I'd like to know more about your hero as well, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See?! We all wanna hear what happened!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I mean, sure...
But we need to practice first since it's a pretty long story.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Then, let's do our best during practice! It'll make her story just that much better!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It took me a little while, but I'm glad I found the answer I was looking for.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I feel so relieved after clearly figuring out what matters most to me.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I did before our careers as pros got underway. I know what I need to do moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Am I any closer to her now?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I dunno, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I'm gonna keep going step by step.
And in order to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We need to keep putting on performances that really move the hearts of everyone listening...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And then, maybe I can be like her someday...)
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
(There's so much left to do...
The release of their debut single, putting together all those marketing events, planning shows, concerts and other performances...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: What else is there...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Oh, they'll need to choose who their leader's going to be soon.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Someone who can support their band through thick and thin. A sort of unyielding pillar of strength...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I suppose she's the only option...
